messages.subject: Re: problem installing quickcheck
parts:
Sorry for the trouble. Not many people install quickcheck since it's needed only if you want to run R CMD check. Those people seem to get it from the repo directly, but it doesn't mean we shouldn't make it easier. In any event, it's not ready for prime time and general use. But in your case I think the failures are not serious and the package is ready to install, in fact it was installed and loaded successfully as apparent from your logs. See inline comments. Let me know how things go

Antonio

On Friday, January 25, 2013 5:35:16 PM UTC-8, Christopher Paciorek wrote:
I tried to install quickcheck but ran into two issues:

1) I don't see a tarball of the package on the RHadoop github repository.

There isn't.
 
2) I did a git clone and built the package from the source files. When I tried to install on an Ubuntu 12.04 machine running R 2.15.2, I ran into errors with the package documentation

You need a complete tex distro. Normally those errors don't prevent installation. When I am installing on EC2 I never ever bother to install tex and I've been testing happily that way forever. There must be something else going on.
